Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
My God, do not discipline me with Your punishment
And do not plot against me with Your strategy

Arabic text: مِنْ أَيْنَ لِيَ الْخَيْرُ يَا رَبِّ
Translation: From where can I obtain good, O Lord
When it can only be found with You
And from where can I find salvation
When it cannot be attained except through You

Arabic text: لَا الَّذِيْ أَحْسَنَ اسْتَغْنىٰ عَنْ عَوْنِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: Neither can one who does good dispense with Your help and mercy
Nor can one who did wrong and displeased You
Escape from Your power
O Lord
Through You I have known You
It is You who guided me to Yourself
And invited me to You

Arabic text: وَلَوْلَا أَنْتَ لَمْ أَدْرِ مَا أَنْتَ
Translation: Had it not been for You, I would not have known who You are
All praise is for Allah whom I call and He answers me
Even though I am slow to respond when He calls me
And praise be to Allah whom I ask and He gives to me
Even though I am stingy when He seeks a loan from me

Arabic text: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ أُنَادِيهِ كُلَّمَا شِئْتُ لِحَاجَتِيْ
Translation: And praise be to Allah whom I call whenever I wish for my needs

Arabic text: وَأَخْلُوْ بِهِ حَيْثُ شِئْتُ لِسِرِّى بِغَيْرِ شَفِيعٍ
Translation: And confide in Him privately for my secrets without any intermediary
So He fulfills my need
All praise is for Allah whom I do not call upon anyone but Him

Arabic text: وَلَوْ دَعَوْتُ غَيْرَهُ لَمْ يَسْتَجِبْ لِيْ دُعَائِي
Translation: If I were to call upon others, they would not answer my prayer
And praise be to Allah in whom I place my hope in none but Him
If I were to hope in others, they would disappoint my hope

Arabic text: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ وَكَّلَنِيْ إِلَيْهِ فَأَكْرَمَنِي
Translation: And praise be to Allah who entrusted me to Him and honored me
And did not leave me to the people who would humiliate me
And praise be to Allah who endeared Himself to me
Though He is free of any need for me
And praise be to Allah who is forbearing with me
As if I have no sins
So my Lord is most deserving of my praise
And most worthy of my gratitude

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَجِدُ سُبُلَ الْمَطَالِبِ إِلَيْكَ مُشْرَعَةً
Translation: O Allah, I find the paths of requests to You wide open
And the springs of hope with You overflowing
And seeking help through Your favor is permissible for those who hope in You
And the doors of prayer are open to those who cry out to You
And I know that You are for those who hope in You a place of answered prayer
And for those in distress a place of relief
And that in yearning for Your generosity
And being content with Your decree
Is a compensation for what the miserly withhold
And a substitute for what the selfish possess
And that the one journeying to You is near in distance
And that You do not veil Yourself from Your creation
Except when their evil deeds block them from You
And I have directed myself to You with my request
And turned to You with my need
And I have made my plea for help to You
And my means of gaining access is through supplicating to You
Not because I deserve to be heard by You
Nor for being worthy of Your pardon
But because of my trust in Your generosity
And my reliance on the truthfulness of Your promise
And my seeking refuge in my faith in Your Oneness
And my certainty in the knowledge that
I have no Lord but You
And there is no deity except You
Alone without any partner
O Allah, You are the One who said - and Your word is true
And Your promise is truthful
"Ask Allah from His grace
Indeed Allah is ever merciful to you"
And it is not of Your attributes, O my Master
To command asking and then withhold giving

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بِالْعَطِيَّاتِ عَلَى أَهْلِ مَمْلَكَتِكَ
Translation: You are the Bestower of gifts upon the people of Your kingdom
And the One who returns to them with the tenderness of Your mercy

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ رَبَّيْتَنِيْ فِيْ نِعَمِكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ صَغِيرًا
Translation: My God, You nurtured me in Your blessings and favors when I was small
And You exalted my name when I grew up

Arabic text: فَيَا مَنْ رَبَّانِيْ فِيْ الدُّنْيَا بِإِحْسَانِهِ
Translation: O He who raised me in this world with His kindness
His favor, and His blessings

Arabic text: وَأَشَارَ لِيْ فِيْ الْآخِرَةِ إِلٰى عَفْوِهِ وَكَرَمِهِ
Translation: And pointed me in the hereafter to His pardon and generosity
My knowledge of You, O my Master, is my guide to You
And my love for You is my intercessor to You
And I am confident in my guide because of Your guidance
And assured about my intercessor because of Your intercession

Arabic text: أَدْعُوكَ يَا سَيِّدِيْ بِلِسَانٍ قَدْ أَخْرَسَهُ ذَنْبُهُ
Translation: I call upon You, O my Master, with a tongue that has been silenced by its sin

Arabic text: رَبِّ أُنَاجِيكَ بِقَلْبٍ قَدْ أَوْبَقَهُ جُرْمُهُ
Translation: O Lord, I converse with You with a heart that has been ruined by its offense
I call upon You, O Lord, fearful yet hopeful
Hoping yet afraid
When I see my sins, O my Master, I become frightened
And when I see Your generosity, I become hopeful
So if You forgive, You are the best of those who show mercy
And if You punish, You have not been unjust

Arabic text: حُجَّتِيْ يَا اَللَّهُ فِيْ جُرْأَتِيْ عَلَى مَسْأَلَتِكَ
Translation: My argument, O Allah, in my daring to ask You

Arabic text: مَعَ إِتْيَانِيْ مَا تَكْرَهُ جُودُكَ وَكَرَمُكَ
Translation: Despite having done what You dislike, is Your generosity and Your munificence

Arabic text: وَعُدَّتِيْ فِيْ شِدَّتِيْ مَعَ قِلَّةِ حَيَائِي رَأْفَتُكَ وَرَحْمَتُكَ
Translation: And my provision in my hardship, despite my lack of modesty, is Your compassion and mercy

Arabic text: وَقَدْ رَجَوْتُ أَنْ لَاتَخِيبَ بَيْنَ ذَيْنِ وَذَيْنِ مُنْيَتِيْ
Translation: And I hope that my wish will not be disappointed between these two
So fulfill my hope
And hear my prayer
O Best of those whom a caller has called
And Best of those in whom a hoper has placed hope

Arabic text: عَظُمَ يَا سَيِّدِيْ أَمَلِيْ وَسَاءَ عَمَلِيْ
Translation: Great is my hope, O my Master, and bad is my deed
So grant me from Your pardon according to the extent of my hope
And do not hold me accountable for the worst of my deeds

Arabic text: فَإِنَّ كَرَمَكَ يَجِلُّ عَنْ مُجَازَاةِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ
Translation: For Your generosity is too great to punish the sinners
And Your forbearance is too vast to repay the negligent
And I, O my Master, seek refuge in Your bounty
I flee from You to You

Arabic text: مُتَنَجِّزٌ مَا وَعَدْتَ مِنَ الصَّفْحِ عَمَّنْ أَحْسَنَ بِكَ ظَنًّا
Translation: Anticipating the promise of forgiveness which You have granted to one who had good thoughts of You

Arabic text: وَمَا أَنَا يَا رَبِّ وَمَا خَطَرِيْ
Translation: And what am I, O Lord, and what is my significance?
Grant me through Your favor
And be charitable to me through Your pardon
O Lord, cover me with Your veil
And refrain from rebuking me by the honor of Your face

Arabic text: فَلَوِ اطَّلَعَ الْيَوْمَ عَلَى ذَنْبِىْ غَيْرُكَ مَا فَعَلْتُهُ
Translation: For if anyone besides You had known of my sin today, I would not have done it
And had I feared immediate punishment, I would have avoided it
Not because You are the least significant of watchers to me
And the lightest of observers over me

Arabic text: بَلْ لِأَنَّكَ يَا رَبِّ خَيْرُ السَّاتِرِينَ
Translation: But because You, O Lord, are the best of concealers
The Wisest of judges
And the Most Generous of the generous
Concealer of faults
Forgiver of sins
Knower of the unseen
You cover the sin with Your generosity
And delay the punishment with Your forbearance

Arabic text: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى حِلْمِكَ بَعْدَ عِلْمِكَ
Translation: So praise be to You for Your forbearance despite Your knowledge
And for Your pardon despite Your power

Arabic text: وَيَحْمِلُنِيْ وَيُجَرِّئُنِيْ عَلَى مَعْصِيَتِكَ حِلْمُكَ عَنِّي
Translation: What emboldens me to disobey You is Your forbearance with me

Arabic text: وَيَدْعُونِيْ إِلٰى قِلَّةِ الْحَيَاءِ سِتْرُكَ عَلَيَّ
Translation: And what invites me to lack modesty is Your concealment of my faults

Arabic text: وَيُسْرِعُنِيْ إِلٰى التَّوَثُّبِ عَلَى مَحَارِمِكَ مَعْرِفَتِيْ بِسَعَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَعَظِيمِ عَفْوِكَ
Translation: And what hastens me to leap into the forbidden is my knowledge of the vastness of Your mercy and the greatness of Your pardon
O Forbearing, O Generous
O Living, O Self-Subsisting
O Forgiver of sin
O Acceptor of repentance
O Great in beneficence
O Ancient in favor
Where is Your beautiful covering
Where is Your sublime pardon
Where is Your near relief
Where is Your quick help
Where is Your vast mercy
Where are Your abundant gifts
Where are Your pleasant bestowals
Where are Your beautiful favors
Where is Your great bounty
Where is Your immense blessing
Where is Your ancient beneficence
Where is Your generosity, O Generous

Arabic text: بِهِ وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ فَاسْتَنْقِذْنِي
Translation: By it and by Muhammad and his family, rescue me
And by Your mercy, save me
O Benevolent
O Beautiful
O Bestower of blessings, O Gracious

Arabic text: لَسْتُ أَتَّكِلُ فِيْ النَّجَاةِ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ عَلَى أَعْمَالِنَا
Translation: I do not rely for my salvation from Your punishment upon our deeds
But upon Your favor toward us
For You are the Lord of righteousness and the Lord of forgiveness
You initiate with blessings as favor
And pardon sin out of generosity
So we do not know what to thank You for

Arabic text: أَجَمِيلَ مَا تَنْشُرُ أَمْ قَبِيحَ مَا تَسْتُرُ
Translation: Is it for the good that You spread or the bad that You conceal
Or for the great trials You have averted and given

Arabic text: أَمْ كَثِيرَ مَا مِنْهُ نَجَّيْتَ وَعَافَيْتَ
Translation: Or for the many things from which You have saved us and cured us
O Beloved of those who love You

Arabic text: وَيَا قُرَّةَ عَيْنِ مَنْ لاَذَ بِكَ وَانْقَطَعَ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And O Delight of the eyes of those who seek refuge in You and dedicate themselves to You
You are the Benevolent and we are the wrongdoers

Arabic text: فَتَجَاوَزْ يَا رَبِّ عَنْ قَبِيحِ مَا عِنْدَنَا بِجَمِيلِ مَا عِنْدَكَ
Translation: So overlook, O Lord, the ugliness of what we have with the beauty of what You have

Arabic text: وَأَيُّ جَهْلٍ يَا رَبِّ لَايَسَعُهُ جُودُكَ
Translation: And what ignorance, O Lord, is not accommodated by Your generosity

Arabic text: أَوْ أَيُّ زَمَانٍ أَطْوَلُ مِنْ أَنَاتِكَ
Translation: Or what time is longer than Your patience

Arabic text: وَمَا قَدْرُ أَعْمَالِنَا فِيْ جَنْبِ نِعَمِكَ
Translation: And what significance do our deeds have beside Your favors

Arabic text: وَكَيْفَ نَسْتَكْثِرُ أَعْمَالًا نُقَابِلُ بِهَا كَرَمَكَ
Translation: And how can we regard many any deeds with which we meet Your generosity

Arabic text: بَلْ كَيْفَ يَضِيقُ عَلَى الْمُذْنِبِينَ مَا وَسِعَهُمْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: Rather, how can Your vast mercy be narrowed for the sinners
O Possessor of vast forgiveness
O One who extends His hands with mercy

Arabic text: فَوَعِزَّتِكَ يَا سَيِّدِيْ لَوْ نَهَرْتَنِيْ مَا بَرِحْتُ مِنْ بَابِكَ
Translation: By Your might, O Master, if You were to turn me away, I would not leave Your door
And I would not cease to praise You

Arabic text: لِمَا انْتَهىٰ إِلَيَّ مِنَ الْمَعْرِفَةِ بِجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ
Translation: Because of the knowledge that has reached me of Your generosity and bounty
You are the doer of what You wish

Arabic text: تُعَذِّبُ مَنْ تَشَاءُ بِمَا تَشَاءُ كَيْفَ تَشَاءُ
Translation: You punish whom You wish, as You wish, how You wish

Arabic text: وَتَرْحَمُ مَنْ تَشَاءُ بِمَا تَشَاءُ كَيْفَ تَشَاءُ
Translation: And You show mercy to whom You wish, as You wish, how You wish
You are not questioned about what You do
Nor are You contested in Your kingdom
Nor are You challenged in Your authority
Nor are You opposed in Your judgment

Arabic text: وَلَا يَعْتَرِضُ عَلَيْكَ أَحَدٌ فِيْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
Translation: Nor does anyone object to You in Your management
To You belongs creation and command
Blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds

Arabic text: يَا رَبِّ هٰذَا مَقَامُ مَنْ لاَذَ بِكَ
Translation: O Lord, this is the position of one who sought refuge in You
And took shelter in Your generosity
And became accustomed to Your favor and blessings
And You are the Generous whose pardon is never constricted
And whose favor is never diminished
And whose mercy is never reduced
And we have trusted in Your ancient forgiveness
And Your great favor and vast mercy
Do You think, O Lord, that You would disappoint our expectations
Or dash our hopes

Arabic text: كَلَّا يَا كَرِيمُ فَلَيْسَ هٰذَا ظَنُّنَا بِكَ
Translation: No, O Generous, this is not our opinion of You
Nor is this what we hope from You

Arabic text: يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ لَنَا فِيكَ أَمَلًا طَوِيلًا كَثِيرًا
Translation: O Lord, we have in You a great and abundant hope
We have in You a mighty hope

Arabic text: عَصَيْنَاكَ وَنَحْنُ نَرْجُوْ أَنْ تَسْتُرَ عَلَيْنَا
Translation: We disobeyed You while hoping that You would cover our sins

Arabic text: وَدَعَوْنَاكَ وَنَحْنُ نَرْجُوْ أَنْ تَسْتَجِيبَ لَنَا
Translation: And we called upon You while hoping that You would answer us
So fulfill our hope, our Master
For we know what we deserve by our deeds

Arabic text: وَلٰكِنْ عِلْمُكَ فِينَا وَعِلْمُنَا بِأَنَّكَ لَاتَصْرِفُنَا عَنْكَ
Translation: But Your knowledge of us and our knowledge that You will not turn us away from You
Has prompted us to desire from You
Even if we are not deserving of Your mercy

Arabic text: فَأَنْتَ أَهْلٌ أَنْ تَجُودَ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى الْمُذْنِبِينَ بِفَضْلِ سَعَتِكَ
Translation: You are worthy to bestow upon us and upon all sinners through Your vast grace
So favor us with what You are worthy of

Arabic text: وَجُدْ عَلَيْنَا فَإِنَّا مُحْتَاجُونَ إِلٰى نَيْلِكَ
Translation: And grant us, for we are in need of Your bounty
O Forgiver, by Your light we are guided
And by Your favor we are enriched
And by Your blessing we begin our mornings and evenings
Our sins are before You
We ask Your forgiveness, O Allah, from them and repent to You
You endear Yourself to us with blessings while we counter You with sins
Your good descends upon us
While our evil ascends to You

Arabic text: وَلَمْ يَزَلْ وَلَا يَزَالُ مَلَكٌ كَرِيمٌ يَأْتِيكَ عَنَّا بِعَمَلٍ قَبِيحٍ
Translation: A noble angel always brings You our ugly deeds

Arabic text: فَلَا يَمْنَعُكَ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنْ تَحُوْطَنَا بِنِعَمِكَ
Translation: But that does not prevent You from surrounding us with Your blessings
And favoring us with Your bounties
Glory be to You! How forbearing, how great
And how generous You are, as Beginner and Repeater
Holy are Your names
Exalted is Your praise
And noble are Your works and deeds
You, my God, are too vast in bounty

Arabic text: وَأَعْظَمُ حِلْمًا مِنْ أَنْ تُقَايِسَنِيْ بِفِعْلِيْ وَخَطِيئَتِيْ
Translation: And too great in forbearance to punish me for my deed and my sin
So pardon, pardon, pardon
My Master, my Master, my Master
O Allah, occupy us with Your remembrance
And protect us from Your wrath
And save us from Your punishment
And provide for us from Your gifts
And bestow upon us from Your favor
And grant us the pilgrimage to Your House
And the visitation to the grave of Your Prophet
May Your blessings and mercy

Arabic text: وَمَغْفِرَتُكَ وَرِضْوَانُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
Translation: And forgiveness and pleasure be upon him and his household
Indeed, You are near, responsive
And grant us work in Your obedience
And take our souls while we are on Your religion and the way of Your Prophet
May Allah bless him and his family
O Allah, forgive me and my parents
And have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small
Reward them for their good with goodness
And for their sins with forgiveness
O Allah, forgive the believing men and believing women
The living among them and the dead
And make harmony between us and them in good deeds
O Allah, forgive our living and our dead
Our present and our absent
Our males and our females
Our young and our old
Our free and our enslaved
Those who associate partners with Allah have lied
And have gone far astray
And have incurred a manifest loss

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And end my life with goodness

Arabic text: وَاكْفِنِيْ مَا أَهَمَّنِيْ مِنْ أَمْرِ دُنْيَايَ وَ آخِرَتِيْ
Translation: And spare me what worries me of the affairs of this world and the hereafter
And do not give authority over me to one who will not show me mercy
And place upon me from You an enduring shield

Arabic text: وَلَا تَسْلُبْنِيْ صَالِحَ مَا أَنْعَمْتَ بِهِ عَلَيَّ
Translation: And do not strip from me the good with which You have blessed me

Arabic text: وَارْزُقْنِيْ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ رِزْقًا وَاسِعًا حَلالًا طَيِّبًا
Translation: And grant me from Your favor a vast, lawful, and good provision
O Allah, guard me with Your guardianship
And protect me with Your protection
And preserve me with Your preservation
And grant me the pilgrimage to Your Sacred House

Arabic text: فِيْ عَامِنَا هٰذَا وَفِيْ كُلِّ عَامٍ
Translation: In this year and in every year

Arabic text: وَزِيَارَةَ قَبْرِ نَبِيِّكَ وَالْأَئِمَّةِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلامُ
Translation: And the visitation to the grave of Your Prophet and the Imams, peace be upon them

Arabic text: وَلَا تُخْلِنِيْ يَا رَبِّ مِنْ تِلْكَ الْمَشَاهِدِ الشَّرِيفَةِ
Translation: And do not deprive me, O Lord, of visiting those noble shrines
And honorable places
O Allah, accept my repentance so that I do not disobey You
And inspire me to do good and act upon it
And to fear You by night and day as long as You keep me alive
O Lord of the worlds

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي كُلَّمَا قُلْتُ قَدْ تَهَيَّأْتُ وَتَعَبَّأْتُ
Translation: O Allah, whenever I say that I have prepared and made ready
And stood to pray before You and conversed with You

Arabic text: أَلْقَيْتَ عَلَيَّ نُعَاسًا إِذَا أَنَا صَلَّيْتُ
Translation: You cast upon me drowsiness when I pray
And You deprive me of conversation with You when I commune with You

Arabic text: مَالِيْ كُلَّمَا قُلْتُ قَدْ صَلُحَتْ سَرِيرَتِيْ
Translation: Why is it that whenever I say my inner thoughts have become righteous
And my company has drawn near to the company of those who repent

Arabic text: عَرَضَتْ لِيْ بَلِيَّةٌ أَزَالَتْ قَدَمِيْ وَحَالَتْ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ خِدْمَتِكَ
Translation: A trial comes to me that causes my feet to slip and prevents me from serving You
My Master, perhaps You have cast me away from Your door
And removed me from Your service

Arabic text: أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ رَأَيْتَنِيْ مُسْتَخِفًّا بِحَقِّكَ فَأَقْصَيْتَنِي
Translation: Or perhaps You saw me belittling Your right, so You distanced me

Arabic text: أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ رَأَيْتَنِيْ مُعْرِضًا عَنْكَ فَقَلَيْتَنِي
Translation: Or perhaps You saw me turning away from You, so You withdrew from me

Arabic text: أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ وَجَدْتَنِيْ فِيْ مَقَامِ الْكَاذِبِينَ فَرَفَضْتَنِي
Translation: Or perhaps You found me in the position of liars, so You rejected me

Arabic text: أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ رَأَيْتَنِيْ غَيْرَ شَاكِرٍ لِنَعْمَائِكَ فَحَرَمْتَنِي
Translation: Or perhaps You saw me ungrateful for Your blessings, so You deprived me

Arabic text: أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ فَقَدْتَنِيْ مِنْ مَجَالِسِ الْعُلَمَاءِ فَخَذَلْتَنِي
Translation: Or perhaps You found me absent from the gatherings of scholars, so You forsook me

Arabic text: أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ رَأَيْتَنِيْ فِيْ الْغَافِلِينَ فَمِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ آيَسْتَنِي
Translation: Or perhaps You saw me among the heedless, so You despaired me of Your mercy

Arabic text: أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ رَأَيْتَنِيْ آلِفَ مَجَالِسِ الْبَطَّالِينَ فَبَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ خَلَّيْتَنِي
Translation: Or perhaps You saw me frequenting the gatherings of the idle, so You abandoned me to them

Arabic text: أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ لَمْ تُحِبَّ أَنْ تَسْمَعَ دُعَائِي فَبَاعَدْتَنِي
Translation: Or perhaps You did not like to hear my supplication, so You kept me away
Or perhaps You have punished me for my crime and sin

Arabic text: أَوْ لَعَلَّكَ بِقِلَّةِ حَيَائِي مِنْكَ جَازَيْتَنِي
Translation: Or perhaps You have requited me for my lack of modesty toward You

Arabic text: فَإِنْ عَفَوْتَ يَا رَبِّ فَطَالَمَا عَفَوْتَ عَنِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ قَبْلِيْ
Translation: But if You pardon, O Lord, You have often pardoned sinners before me

Arabic text: لِأَنَّ كَرَمَكَ أَىْ رَبِّ يَجِلُّ عَنْ مُكَافَاةِ الْمُقَصِّرِينَ
Translation: For Your generosity, O Lord, is too lofty to repay the inadequate

Arabic text: وَأَنَا عَائِذٌ بِفَضْلِكَ هَارِبٌ مِنْكَ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And I seek refuge in Your bounty, fleeing from You to You

Arabic text: مُتَنَجِّزٌ مَا وَعَدْتَ مِنَ الصَّفْحِ عَمَّنْ أَحْسَنَ بِكَ ظَنًّا
Translation: Expecting the promise of forgiveness which You have granted to one who had good thoughts of You
My God, You are more vast in favor

Arabic text: وَأَعْظَمُ حِلْمًا مِنْ أَنْ تُقَايِسَنِيْ بِعَمَلِيْ
Translation: And greater in forbearance than to rebuke me for my deeds
Or to disgrace me for my sins

Arabic text: وَمَا أَنَا يَا سَيِّدِيْ وَمَا خَطَرِيْ
Translation: And what am I, O my Master, and what is my significance?
Grant me through Your favor, my Master
And be charitable to me with Your pardon
And cover me with Your veil
And forgive me my rebuke by the honor of Your face
My Master, I am the young whom You have raised
And I am the ignorant whom You have taught
And I am the misguided whom You have guided
And I am the lowly whom You have elevated
And I am the fearful whom You have reassured
And the hungry whom You have fed
And the thirsty whom You have quenched
And the naked whom You have clothed
And the poor whom You have enriched
And the weak whom You have strengthened
And the humble whom You have honored
And the sick whom You have cured
And the beggar whom You have given
And the sinner whose faults You have concealed
And the wrongdoer whom You have excused
And I am the little You have made much
And the oppressed whom You have helped
And I am the expelled whom You have sheltered

Arabic text: أَنَا يَا رَبِّ الَّذِيْ لَمْ أَسْتَحْيِكَ فِيْ الْخَلاءِ
Translation: I am, O Lord, the one who did not feel shy of You in private
And did not observe You in public
I am the possessor of great calamities
I am the one who dared against his Master
I am the one who disobeyed the Almighty of the heavens

Arabic text: أَنَا الَّذِيْ أَعْطَيْتُ عَلَى مَعَاصِيْ الْجَلِيلِ الرُّشَى
Translation: I am the one who gave bribes for the sins of the Majestic

Arabic text: أَنَا الَّذِيْ حِيْنَ بُشِّرْتُ بِهَا خَرَجْتُ إِلَيْهَا أَسْعَى
Translation: I am the one who, when I was given glad tidings of these sins, rushed to them eagerly
I am the one whom You gave respite but I did not restrain myself
And You veiled my sins but I did not feel shy
And I committed sins and transgressed
And You let me fall from Your regard but I did not care
By Your forbearance You gave me respite
And with Your veil You covered me until it was as if You had overlooked me

Arabic text: وَمِنْ عُقُوبَاتِ الْمَعَاصِيْ جَنَّبْتَنِيْ حَتَّىٰ كَأَنَّكَ اسْتَحْيَيْتَنِي
Translation: And You spared me the punishments for sins until it was as if You were shy of me

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ لَمْ أَعْصِكَ حِيْنَ عَصَيْتُكَ وَأَنَا بِرُبُوبِيَّتِكَ جَاحِدٌ
Translation: My God, I did not disobey You when I disobeyed You while denying Your Lordship
Nor belittling Your command
Nor exposing myself to Your punishment
Nor disregarding Your threat

Arabic text: لَكِنْ خَطِيئَةٌ عَرَضَتْ وَسَوَّلَتْ لِيْ نَفْسِي
Translation: But a sin presented itself, and my self tempted me
And my desires overcame me
And my misfortune helped me to it
And Your veil drawn over me deceived me
So I disobeyed You and opposed You with my full effort
So now, who can save me from Your punishment

Arabic text: وَمِنْ أَيْدِيْ الْخُصَمَاءِ غَدًا مَنْ يُخَلِّصُنِي
Translation: And who can rescue me from the hands of my adversaries tomorrow

Arabic text: وَبِحَبْلِ مَنْ أَتَّصِلُ إِنْ أَنْتَ قَطَعْتَ حَبْلَكَ عَنِّي
Translation: And to whose rope shall I cling if You cut Your rope from me

Arabic text: فَوَا سَوْأَتَا عَلَى مَا فَوَاأَحْصٰى كِتَابُكَ مِنْ عَمَلِيْ
Translation: Oh, how I will regret what Your book has enumerated of my deeds

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ لَوْلَا مَا أَرْجُوْ مِنْ كَرَمِكَ وَسَعَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: For if not for what I hope from Your generosity and vast mercy

Arabic text: وَنَهْيِكَ إِيَّايَ عَنِ الْقُنُوطِ لَقَنَطْتُ عِنْدَمَا أَتَذَكَّرُهَا
Translation: And Your prohibition against despair, I would have despaired when I remember them
O Best of those whom a caller has called
And Best of those in whom a hoper has placed hope
O Allah, by the covenant of Islam I beseech You
And by the sanctity of the Quran I rely on You
And by my love for the unlettered Prophet
The Qurayshi, the Hashimi
The Arab, the Tihamian
The Meccan, the Medinan
I hope for nearness to You
So do not make desolate the familiarity of my faith

Arabic text: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ ثَوَابِىْ ثَوَابَ مَنْ عَبَدَ سِوَاكَ
Translation: And do not make my reward the reward of one who worshiped other than You

Arabic text: فَإِنَّ قَوْمًا آمَنُوْا بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ لِيَحْقِنُوْا بِهِ دِمَاءَهُمْ
Translation: For there are people who believed with their tongues to save their blood
And they attained what they hoped for

Arabic text: وَإِنَّا آمَنَّا بِكَ بِأَلْسِنَتِنَا وَقُلُوبِنَا لِتَعْفُوَ عَنَّا
Translation: And we have believed in You with our tongues and hearts so that You may pardon us
So let us attain what we hope for
And establish our hope in You in our breasts

Arabic text: وَلَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا
Translation: And do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us
And grant us from You mercy
Indeed, You are the Bestower

Arabic text: فَوَعِزَّتِكَ لَوِ انْتَهَرْتَنِيْ مَا بَرِحْتُ مِنْ بَابِكَ
Translation: By Your might, if You were to rebuke me, I would not leave Your door
And I would not cease flattering You

Arabic text: لِمَا أُلْهِمَ قَلْبِىْ مِنَ الْمَعْرِفَةِ بِكَرَمِكَ وَسَعَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: Because of what my heart has been inspired with of knowledge of Your generosity and vast mercy

Arabic text: إِلٰى مَنْ يَذْهَبُ الْعَبْدُ إِلَّا إِلٰى مَوْلاَهُ
Translation: To whom can a servant go except to his Master

Arabic text: وَإِلٰى مَنْ يَلْتَجِئُ الْمَخْلُوقُ إِلَّا إِلٰى خَالِقِهِ
Translation: And to whom can a created being seek refuge except to its Creator
My God, if You were to chain me in shackles
And deprive me of Your flowing favor before the witnesses
And indicate my scandals to the eyes of the servants
And command me to the Fire
And separate me from the righteous
I would not cut off my hope in You
And I would not despair of Your pardon
And love for You would not leave my heart
I do not forget Your favors to me
And Your concealment of me in the worldly abode

Arabic text: سَيِّدِيْ أَخْرِجْ حُبَّ الدُّنْيَا مِنْ قَلْبِيْ
Translation: My Master, remove the love of this world from my heart

Arabic text: وَاجْمَعْ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ الْمُصْطَفَى وَ آلِهِ
Translation: And gather me with the Chosen One and his family
The best of Your creation and the Seal of the Prophets

Arabic text: مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ
Translation: Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family
And transfer me to the rank of repentance to You

Arabic text: وَأَعِنِّي بِالْبُكَاءِ عَلَى نَفْسِيْ فَقَدْ أَفْنَيْتُ عُمْرِيْ
Translation: And help me to weep for myself, for I have wasted my life

Arabic text: وَقَدْ نَزَلْتُ مَنْزِلَةَ الْآيِسِينَ مِنْ خَيْرِيْ
Translation: And I have reached the state of those who despair of any good from me
So who can be in a worse state than me

Arabic text: إِنْ أَنَا نُقِلْتُ عَلَى مِثْلِ حَالِيْ
Translation: If I am transferred in my present condition
To a grave that I have not prepared for my rest
And have not furnished with righteous deeds for my repose
And why should I not weep

Arabic text: وَلَا أَدْرِيْ إِلٰى مَا يَكُونُ مَصِيرِيْ
Translation: When I do not know what my end will be
And I see that my self deceives me
And my days deceive me

Arabic text: وَقَدْ خَفَقَتْ عِنْدَ رَأْسِيْ أَجْنِحَةُ الْمَوْتِ
Translation: And the wings of death have fluttered near my head
So why should I not weep
I weep for the departure of my soul
I weep for the darkness of my grave
I weep for the narrowness of my tomb
I weep for the questioning of Munkar and Nakir of me

Arabic text: أَبْكِيْ لِخُرُوجِيْ مِنْ قَبْرِيْ عُرْيَانًا ذَلِيْلًا
Translation: I weep for my emergence from my grave naked and humiliated
Carrying my burden upon my back

Arabic text: أَنْظُرُ مَرَّةً عَنْ يَمِينِيْ وَأُخْرىٰ عَنْ شِمَالِيْ
Translation: Looking once to my right and once to my left

Arabic text: إِذِ الْخَلائِقُ فِيْ شَأْنٍ غَيْرِ شَأْنِي
Translation: When the creatures will be in a state other than my state

Arabic text: لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
Translation: "Every person that Day will have a concern that suffices him"
"Faces on that Day will be bright, laughing, rejoicing"

Arabic text: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ وَذِلَّةٌ
Translation: "And faces on that Day will have dust upon them, covered with darkness and humiliation"
My Master, upon You is my reliance and my trust
And my hope and my dependence
And to Your mercy is my clinging
You bestow with Your mercy upon whom You will
And You guide with Your generosity whom You love

Arabic text: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا نَقَّيْتَ مِنَ الشِّرْكِ قَلْبِيْ
Translation: So praise be to You for having purified my heart from polytheism
And praise be to You for having loosened my tongue
Is it with this dull tongue that I should thank You

Arabic text: أَمْ بِغَايَةِ جُهْدِيْ فِيْ عَمَلِيْ أُرْضِيكَ
Translation: Or with the utmost effort in my deeds that I should please You

Arabic text: وَمَا قَدْرُ لِسَانِيْ يَا رَبِّ فِيْ جَنْبِ شُكْرِكَ
Translation: And what is the value of my tongue, O Lord, alongside Your gratitude

Arabic text: وَمَا قَدْرُ عَمَلِيْ فِيْ جَنْبِ نِعَمِكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ
Translation: And what is the value of my deeds alongside Your favors and goodness
My God, Your generosity has expanded my hope
And Your acceptance has led to the acceptance of my deeds
My Master, to You is my desire
And to You is my fear
And to You is my aspiration
And my hope has driven me to You
And upon You, O my Only One, has my determination focused
And toward what is with You has my desire expanded
And for You is the purity of my hope and fear
And with You my love has found comfort
And to You I have extended my hand
And with the rope of Your obedience I have extended my fear
O my Master, through Your remembrance my heart has lived
And through conversing with You I have cooled the pain of my fear

Arabic text: فَيَا مَوْلاَيَ وَيَا مُؤَمَّلِيْ وَيَا مُنْتَهىٰ سُؤْلِيْ
Translation: So, O my Master, O my Hope, O my Ultimate Goal

Arabic text: فَرِّقْ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ ذَنْبِيَ الْمَانِعِ لِيْ مِنْ لُزُومِ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: Separate me from my sin that prevents me from adhering to Your obedience
For I ask You because of my ancient hope in You
And Your great kindness

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ أَوْجَبْتَهُ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ مِنَ الرَّأْفَةِ وَالرَّحْمَةِ
Translation: That You have made obligatory upon Yourself of compassion and mercy

Arabic text: فَالْأَمْرُ لَكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
Translation: For the command belongs to You alone, without any partner
And all creation is Your dependents and in Your grasp
And everything is submissive to You
Blessed are You, O Lord of the worlds
My God, have mercy on me when my argument is cut off
And my tongue fails to answer You
And my mind is bewildered at Your questioning

Arabic text: فَيَا عَظِيمَ رَجَائِي لَاتُخَيِّبْنِيْ إِذَا اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتِيْ
Translation: O Great One of my hope, do not disappoint me when my poverty is severe
And do not reject me for my ignorance
And do not prevent me for my lack of patience
Grant me for my poverty
And have mercy on me for my weakness
My Master, upon You is my dependence and reliance
And my hope and trust
And to Your mercy is my clinging
And in Your courtyard I set down my baggage
And with Your generosity I direct my request
And with Your generosity, O Lord, I begin my supplication
And with You I hope to relieve my poverty
And with Your wealth I repair my destitution
And under the shadow of Your pardon is my standing
And to Your generosity and munificence I raise my sight
And toward Your favor I direct my gaze

Arabic text: فَلَا تُحْرِقْنِيْ بِالنَّارِ وَأَنْتَ مَوْضِعُ أَمَلِيْ
Translation: So do not burn me in the Fire when You are the object of my hope

Arabic text: وَلَا تُسْكِنِّي الْهَاوِيَةَ فَإِنَّكَ قُرَّةُ عَيْنِي
Translation: And do not make me dwell in the abyss, for You are the comfort of my eye

Arabic text: يَا سَيِّدِيْ لَاتُكَذِّبْ ظَنِّي بِإِحْسَانِكَ وَمَعْرُوفِكَ
Translation: O my Master, do not belie my opinion of Your goodness and favor
For You are my trust
And do not deprive me of Your reward
For You are the Knower of my poverty

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ دَنَا أَجَلِيْ وَلَمْ يُقَرِّبْنِيْ مِنْكَ عَمَلِيْ
Translation: My God, if my death is near and my deeds have not brought me near to You

Arabic text: فَقَدْ جَعَلْتُ الْإِعْتِرَافَ إِلَيْكَ بِذَنْبِىْ وَسَائِلَ عِلَلِيْ
Translation: Then I have made the confession of my sins to You a means of excuse

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ إِنْ عَفَوْتَ فَمَنْ أَوْلىٰ مِنْكَ بِالْعَفْوِ
Translation: My God, if You forgive, then who is more worthy of forgiveness than You

Arabic text: وَإِنْ عَذَّبْتَ فَمَنْ أَعْدَلُ مِنْكَ فِيْ الْحُكْمِ
Translation: And if You punish, then who is more just than You in judgment
Have mercy on my estrangement in this world
And on my distress at death
And on my loneliness in the grave
And on my solitude in the tomb

Arabic text: وَإِذَا نُشِرْتُ لِلْحِسَابِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ ذُلَّ مَوْقِفِيْ
Translation: And when I am raised for reckoning before You, the humiliation of my position

Arabic text: وَاغْفِرْ لِيْ مَا خَفِيَ عَلَى الْآدَمِيِّينَ مِنْ عَمَلِيْ
Translation: And forgive me for what is hidden from people of my deeds
And prolong for me that by which You have concealed me

Arabic text: وَارْحَمْنِيْ صَرِيعًا عَلَى الْفِرَاشِ تُقَلِّبُنِيْ أَيْدِيْ أَحِبَّتِيْ
Translation: And have mercy on me lying prostrate on my bed with the hands of my loved ones turning me

Arabic text: وَتَفَضَّلْ عَلَيَّ مَمْدُودًا عَلَى الْمُغْتَسَلِ يُقَلِّبُنِيْ صَالِحُ جِيرَتِيْ
Translation: And be gracious to me stretched out on the washing table with the hands of my righteous neighbors turning me

Arabic text: وَتَحَنَّنْ عَلَيَّ مَحْمُولًا قَدْ تَنَاوَلَ الْأَقْرِبَاءُ أَطْرَافَ جِنَازَتِيْ
Translation: And be kind to me when carried while my relatives have taken the edges of my bier

Arabic text: وَجُدْ عَلَيَّ مَنْقُولًا قَدْ نَزَلْتُ بِكَ وَحِيدًا فِيْ حُفْرَتِيْ
Translation: And be generous to me when transported and I have descended to You alone in my pit

Arabic text: وَارْحَمْ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ الْبَيْتِ الْجَدِيْدِ غُرْبَتِيْ حَتَّىٰ لَاأَسْتَأْنِسَ بِغَيْرِكَ
Translation: And have mercy in that new house on my estrangement until I find comfort in none but You

Arabic text: يَا سَيِّدِيْ إِنْ وَكَلْتَنِيْ إِلٰى نَفْسِيْ هَلَكْتُ
Translation: My Master, if You entrust me to myself, I will perish

Arabic text: سَيِّدِيْ فَبِمَنْ أَسْتَغِيثُ إِنْ لَمْ تُقِلْنِيْ عَثْرَتِيْ
Translation: My Master, to whom shall I appeal if You do not overlook my slip

Arabic text: فَإِلٰى مَنْ أَفْزَعُ إِنْ فَقَدْتُ عِنَايَتَكَ فِيْ ضَجْعَتِيْ
Translation: To whom shall I flee if I lose Your care in my resting place

Arabic text: وَإِلٰى مَنْ أَلْتَجِئُ إِنْ لَمْ تُنَفِّسْ كُرْبَتِيْ
Translation: And to whom shall I turn if You do not relieve my distress
My Master, who is for me
And who will have mercy on me if You do not have mercy on me

Arabic text: وَفَضْلَ مَنْ أُؤَمِّلُ إِنْ عَدِمْتُ فَضْلَكَ يَوْمَ فَاقَتِيْ
Translation: And whose favor can I hope for if I lose Your favor on the day of my need

Arabic text: وَإِلٰى مَنِ الْفِرَارُ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ إِذَا انْقَضىٰ أَجَلِيْ
Translation: And to whom shall I flee from sins when my term is complete
My Master, do not punish me while I hope in You
My God, fulfill my hope
And secure me from my fear

Arabic text: فَإِنَّ كَثْرَةَ ذُنُوبِىْ لَاأَرْجُوْ فِيهَا إِلَّا عَفْوَكَ
Translation: For the abundance of my sins leaves me hoping only in Your pardon
My Master, I ask of You what I do not deserve
And You are the Lord of righteousness and the Lord of forgiveness

Arabic text: فَاغْفِرْ لِيْ وَأَلْبِسْنِيْ مِنْ نَظَرِكَ ثَوْبًا يُغَطِّى عَلَيَّ التَّبِعَاتِ
Translation: So forgive me and clothe me with a look from You that covers my offenses
And forgives them so I will not be asked about them
For You are the Possessor of ancient favor
And great forgiveness
And gracious overlooking

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ تُفِيضُ سَيْبَكَ عَلَى مَنْ لَا يَسْأَلُكَ
Translation: My God, You are the One who causes Your bounty to flow upon those who do not ask You
And upon those who deny Your Lordship

Arabic text: فَكَيْفَ سَيِّدِيْ بِمَنْ سَأَلَكَ وَأَيْقَنَ أَنَّ الْخَلْقَ لَكَ وَالْأَمْرَ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: So how will it be, my Master, with one who asks You and is certain that creation is Yours and the command is to You
Blessed and Exalted are You, O Lord of the worlds

Arabic text: سَيِّدِيْ عَبْدُكَ بِبَابِكَ أَقَامَتْهُ الْخَصَاصَةُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
Translation: My Master, Your servant is at Your door; need has brought him to stand before You
He knocks at the door of Your favor with his prayer
So do not turn Your noble face away from me

Arabic text: وَاقْبَلْ مِنِّي مَا أَقُولُ فَقَدْ دَعَوْتُ بِهٰذَا الدُّعَاءِ
Translation: And accept from me what I say, for I have called with this supplication

Arabic text: وَأَنَا أَرْجُوْ أَنْ لَاتَرُدَّنِيْ مَعْرِفَةً مِنِّي بِرَأْفَتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: And I hope that You will not turn me away, out of my knowledge of Your compassion and mercy

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ لَا يُحْفِيكَ سَائِلٌ
Translation: My God, You are the One whom no petitioner wearies
And no recipient diminishes

Arabic text: أَنْتَ كَمَا تَقُولُ وَفَوْقَ مَا نَقُولُ
Translation: You are as You say and above what we say
O Allah, I ask You for beautiful patience
And near relief
And truthful speech
And great reward

Arabic text: أَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبِّ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ
Translation: I ask You, O Lord, for all goodness

Arabic text: مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ
Translation: That which I know and that which I do not know

Arabic text: أَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ عِبَادُكَ الصَّالِحُونَ
Translation: I ask You, O Allah, for the best of what Your righteous servants have asked of You
O Best of those who are asked
And Most Generous of those who give
Grant me my request for myself and my family
And my parents and my children
And the people of my concern and my brothers in You
And make pleasant my life
And manifest my nobility
And improve all my circumstances
And make me among those whose lives You have lengthened
And whose deeds You have made good
And completed upon them Your blessings, and whom You are pleased with

Arabic text: وَأَحْيَيْتَهُ حَيَاةً طَيِّبَةً فِيْ أَدْوَمِ السُّرُورِ
Translation: And granted a pleasant life in continuous joy
And complete honor and perfect comfort
Indeed, You do what You will
And no one does what they will except You
O Allah, distinguish me with the special quality of Your remembrance

Arabic text: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ شَيْئًا مِمَّا أَتَقَرَّبُ بِهِ
Translation: And do not make anything with which I seek nearness
In the night hours and edges of the day
To be for showing off or for reputation
Or for exultation or pride
And make me among those who humble themselves to You
O Allah, give me abundance in provision
And security in my homeland

Arabic text: وَقُرَّةَ الْعَيْنِ فِيْ الْأَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ وَالْوَلَدِ
Translation: And comfort of the eye in family, wealth, and children
And continuance of Your blessings with me
And health in body
And strength in physique
And safety in religion
And use me in Your obedience and the obedience of Your Messenger

Arabic text: مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ أَبَدًا مَا اسْتَعْمَرْتَنِي
Translation: Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family, as long as You keep me alive

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْنِيْ مِنْ أَوْفَرِ عِبَادِكَ عِنْدَكَ نَصِيبًا
Translation: And make me among Your servants with the most abundant share

Arabic text: فِيْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ أَنْزَلْتَهُ وَتُنْزِلُهُ فِيْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ
Translation: In every good that You have sent down and will send down in the month of Ramadan
On the Night of Decree

Arabic text: وَمَا أَنْتَ مُنْزِلُهُ فِيْ كُلِّ سَنَةٍ مِنْ رَحْمَةٍ تَنْشُرُهَا
Translation: And what You send down every year of mercy that You spread
And well-being that You bestow
And trials that You avert
And good deeds that You accept
And sins that You overlook

Arabic text: وَارْزُقْنِيْ حَجَّ بَيْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ فِيْ عَامِنَا هٰذَا وَفِيْ كُلِّ عَامٍ
Translation: And grant me the pilgrimage to Your Sacred House in this year and every year

Arabic text: وَارْزُقْنِيْ رِزْقًا وَاسِعًا مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْوَاسِعِ
Translation: And provide me with vast provision from Your vast favor
And avert from me, O my Master, the evil things

Arabic text: وَاقْضِ عَنِّيْ الدَّيْنَ وَالظُّلامَاتِ حَتَّىٰ لَا أَتَأَذَّىٰ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْهُ
Translation: And discharge for me my debts and injustices so that I am not harmed by any of them

Arabic text: وَخُذْ عَنِّيْ بِأَسْمَاعِ وَأَبْصَارِ أَعْدَائِي وَحُسَّادِيْ وَالْبَاغِينَ عَلَيَّ
Translation: And take away from me the hearing and sight of my enemies and those who envy me and those who oppress me
And help me against them
And comfort my eye and gladden my heart

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ لِيْ مِنْ هَمِّى وَكَرْبِىْ فَرَجًا وَمَخْرَجًا
Translation: And give me relief and a way out from my worry and distress

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ مَنْ أَرَادَنِيْ بِسُوءٍ مِنْ جَمِيْعِ خَلْقِكَ تَحْتَ قَدَمَيِّ
Translation: And place whoever wishes me ill from all Your creation beneath my feet
And protect me from the evil of Satan
And the evil of the ruler
And the evil of my deeds
And purify me from all sins
And save me from the Fire by Your pardon
And admit me to Paradise by Your mercy
And marry me to the fair ones with wide eyes by Your favor

Arabic text: وَأَلْحِقْنِيْ بِأَوْلِيَائِكَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: And join me with Your righteous friends Muhammad and his family
The pious, the pure, the good, the excellent

Arabic text: صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَعَلَى أَجْسَادِهِمْ وَأَرْوَاحِهِمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
Translation: Your blessings be upon them and upon their bodies and souls, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings
My God and my Master, by Your might and Your majesty
If You were to demand me for my sins, I would demand You for Your pardon
And if You were to demand me for my meanness, I would demand You for Your generosity

Arabic text: وَلَئِنْ أَدْخَلْتَنِيْ النَّارَ لَأُخْبِرَنَّ أَهْلَ النَّارِ بِحُبِّي لَكَ
Translation: And if You were to enter me into the Fire, I would inform its people of my love for You

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ وَسَيِّدِيْ إِنْ كُنْتَ لَاتَغْفِرُ إِلَّا لِأَوْلِيَائِكَ وَأَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: My God and my Master, if You only forgive Your friends and people of obedience
Then to whom will the sinners go

Arabic text: وَإِنْ كُنْتَ لَاتُكْرِمُ إِلَّا أَهْلَ الْوَفَاءِ بِكَ
Translation: And if You only honor those loyal to You
Then by whom will the wrongdoers seek help

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ إِنْ أَدْخَلْتَنِيْ النَّارَ فَفِيْ ذٰلِكَ سُرُورُ عَدُوِّكَ
Translation: My God, if You put me in the Fire, in that is the joy of Your enemy

Arabic text: وَإِنْ أَدْخَلْتَنِيْ الْجَنَّةَ فَفِيْ ذٰلِكَ سُرُورُ نَبِيِّكَ
Translation: And if You admit me to Paradise, in that is the joy of Your Prophet

Arabic text: وَأَنَا وَاللَّهِ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ سُرُورَ نَبِيِّكَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ سُرُورِ عَدُوِّكَ
Translation: And I know, by Allah, that the joy of Your Prophet is more beloved to You than the joy of Your enemy

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَمْلَأَ قَلْبِىْ حُبًّا لَكَ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You to fill my heart with love for You
And with fear of You
And with belief in Your Book
And with faith in You
And with dread of You
And with longing for You

Arabic text: يَا ذَا الْجَلالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ حَبِّبْ إِلَيَّ لِقَاءَكَ
Translation: O Possessor of Majesty and Honor, make me love meeting You
And love my meeting

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ لِيْ فِيْ لِقَائِكَ الرَّاحَةَ وَالْفَرَجَ وَالْكَرَامَةَ
Translation: And make for me in meeting You comfort and relief and honor
O Allah, join me with the righteous who have passed

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْنِيْ مِنْ صَالِحِ مَنْ بَقِيَ وَخُذْ بِىْ سَبِيلَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ
Translation: And place me among the righteous who remain, and lead me on the path of the righteous

Arabic text: وَأَعِنِّي عَلَى نَفْسِيْ بِمَا تُعِينُ بِهِ الصَّالِحِيْنَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ
Translation: And aid me against myself with what You aid the righteous against themselves
And seal my deeds with the best of them
And make my reward from it Paradise by Your mercy
And help me improve what You have given me

Arabic text: وَثَبِّتْنِيْ يَا رَبِّ وَلَا تَرُدَّنِيْ فِيْ سُوءٍ اسْتَنْقَذْتَنِيْ مِنْهُ
Translation: And establish me, O Lord, and do not return me to an evil from which You have saved me
O Lord of the worlds

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا لَاأَجَلَ لَهُ دُوْنَ لِقَائِكَ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You for faith that has no term until I meet You
Keep me alive as long as You keep me alive upon it
And take my soul when You take it while I am upon it
And resurrect me when You resurrect me upon it

Arabic text: وَأَبْرِئْ قَلْبِىْ مِنَ الرِّيَاءِ وَالشَّكِّ وَالسُّمْعَةِ فِيْ دِينِكَ
Translation: And purify my heart from hypocrisy, doubt, and reputation-seeking in Your religion
So that my work is solely for You
O Allah, give me insight in Your religion
And understanding in Your judgment
And comprehension of Your knowledge
And a double portion of Your mercy
And piety that prevents me from disobeying You
And whiten my face with Your light
And make my desire for what is with You

Arabic text: وَتَوَفَّنِيْ فِيْ سَبِيلِكَ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُولِكَ
Translation: And take my soul in Your path and upon the religion of Your Messenger
May Allah bless him and his family

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَالْفَشَلِ
Translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from laziness and failure
And from worry, cowardice, and miserliness
And from heedlessness, hardheartedness, and neediness
And from poverty and destitution

Arabic text: وَكُلِّ بَلِيَّةٍ وَالْفَوَاحِشِ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ
Translation: And from every affliction and from indecencies, what is apparent of them and what is hidden
And I seek refuge in You from a soul that is not satisfied
And a stomach that is not filled
And a heart that does not fear
And a prayer that is not heard
And a deed that does not benefit

Arabic text: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ عَلَى نَفْسِيْ وَدِيْنِيْ وَمَالِيْ
Translation: And I seek refuge with You, O Lord, for myself and my religion and my wealth

Arabic text: وَعَلَى جَمِيْعِ مَا رَزَقْتَنِيْ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
Translation: And for all that You have provided me, from the accursed Satan
Indeed, You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing
O Allah, indeed no one can protect me from You
And I cannot find any refuge besides You

Arabic text: فَلَا تَجْعَلْ نَفْسِيْ فِيْ شَيْءٍ مِنْ عَذَابِكَ
Translation: So do not place my soul in any of Your punishments
And do not return me to destruction
And do not return me to painful torment
O Allah, accept from me
And elevate my remembrance
And raise my rank
And remove my burden
And do not mention me for my sin
And make the reward of my gathering
And the reward of my speech
And the reward of my supplication Your pleasure and Paradise

Arabic text: وَأَعْطِنِيْ يَا رَبِّ جَمِيعَ مَا سَأَلْتُكَ وَزِدْنِيْ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
Translation: And grant me, O Lord, all that I have asked of You and increase me from Your favor

Arabic text: إِنِّي إِلَيْكَ رَاغِبٌ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
Translation: I am earnestly desiring You, O Lord of the worlds

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْزَلْتَ فِيْ كِتَابِكَ أَنْ نَعْفُوَ عَمَّنْ ظَلَمَنَا
Translation: O Allah, You have revealed in Your Book that we should forgive those who wrong us

Arabic text: وَقَدْ ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا فَاعْفُ عَنَّا فَإِنَّكَ أَوْلىٰ بِذٰلِكَ مِنَّا
Translation: And we have wronged ourselves, so forgive us, for You are more worthy of that than we are

Arabic text: وَأَمَرْتَنَا أَنْ لَانَرُدَّ سَائِلًا عَنْ أَبْوَابِنَا
Translation: And You commanded us not to turn away any beggar from our doors

Arabic text: وَقَدْ جِئْتُكَ سَائِلًا فَلَا تَرُدَّنِيْ إِلَّا بِقَضَاءِ حَاجَتِيْ
Translation: And I have come to You as a beggar, so do not turn me away except with the fulfillment of my need

Arabic text: وَأَمَرْتَنَا بِالْإِحْسَانِ إِلٰى مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُنَا
Translation: And You commanded us to treat well those whom our right hands possess

Arabic text: وَنَحْنُ أَرِقَّاؤُكَ فَأَعْتِقْ رِقَابَنَا مِنَ النَّارِ
Translation: And we are Your slaves, so free our necks from the Fire
O my refuge in my distress
And my relief in my hardship
To You I have fled
And with You I have sought help and taken refuge
I do not seek refuge with anyone but You
And I do not seek relief except from You
So help me and relieve me

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ يَقْبَلُ الْيَسِيرَ وَيَعْفُوْ عَنِ الْكَثِيرِ
Translation: O You who accept little and pardon much

Arabic text: اِقْبَلْ مِنِّي الْيَسِيرَ وَاعْفُ عَنِّيْ الْكَثِيرَ
Translation: Accept from me the little and pardon from me the much
Indeed, You are the Merciful, the Forgiving

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا تُبَاشِرُ بِهِ قَلْبِيْ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You for faith that embraces my heart

Arabic text: وَيَقِينًا صَادِقًا حَتَّىٰ أَعْلَمَ أَنَّهُ لَنْ يُصِيبَنِيْ إِلَّا مَا كَتَبْتَ لِيْ
Translation: And truthful certainty so that I know nothing will befall me except what You have decreed for me

Arabic text: وَرَضِّنِيْ مِنَ الْعَيْشِ بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِيْ
Translation: And make me content with the life You have apportioned for me
O Most Merciful of the merciful
